name: Bytebeat Machine
description: Bytebeat instrument: JS-like formulas evaluated at a selectable 4-48 kHz clock, with bytebeat, signed bytebeat and floatbeat output, stereo formulas, A-H macros, free/sync/trigger play modes, and user .bb files from Content/Formulas. Built for MPC OS 3.10.1+ and desktop VST2 hosts.
author: bokontep
